da40.notes: Origin: centre of the bounding box left/right and fore/aft; y = 0 at the bottom of the main tyres (gear down). Diamond DA40 NG (diesel version of the DA40, same airframe). Fixed gear (no gear_retract).

sr22.notes: Origin: centre of the bounding box left/right and fore/aft; y = 0 at the bottom of the main tyres (gear down). Fixed gear (no gear_retract).

pa34.notes: Origin: centre of the bounding box left/right and fore/aft; y = 0 at the bottom of the main tyres (gear down). Older, simple model (about 10,000 triangles). propeller = left engine (engine 0), propeller_2 = right engine.

be350.notes: Origin: centre of the bounding box left/right and fore/aft; y = 0 at the bottom of the main tyres (gear down). propeller = left engine (engine 0), propeller_2 = right engine. Flaps: FlightGear moves them with a rotation plus a translation (Fowler-type); the flap nodes use the single pivot that gives FG's position at full flap (in between it is approximate). flap_left: several segments: turning this node moves them all about the hinge of flap_left_1 (exact for it, approximate for the others); the children have exact hinges.

b738.notes: Origin: centre of the bounding box left/right and fore/aft; y = 0 at the bottom of the main tyres (gear down). FlightGear's default 737-800 paint is plain white (airline liveries are optional); the wings are untextured. This FG model does not animate elevator, rudder or ailerons, so those nodes are absent; slats and engine fans are static. Flaps: FlightGear moves them with a rotation plus a translation (Fowler-type); the flap nodes use the single pivot that gives FG's position at full flap (in between it is approximate).

be36.notes: Origin: centre of the bounding box left/right and fore/aft; y = 0 at the bottom of the main tyres (gear down). Stand-in: FlightGear has no Bonanza; this is a Mooney M20M (also low-wing, retractable gear, four seats). elevator: two halves with swept hinges: turning this node moves both about one lateral axis (approximate); elevator_left / elevator_right have the exact hinges.
